text: Observed in shared-expense-tracker on the e5dbe1f build: `now <work-item-id>` promotes the item and creates openspec/changes/<change>/ holding only origin.json. Until `propose` materializes the change, `work-item render`, `documents validate`, and the pre-commit hook reject the whole tree: first OPENSPEC_CHANGE_TREE_UNSAFE because .openspec.yaml is missing, then MISSING_CHANGE_ARTIFACT for proposal.md once the metadata is scaffolded by hand. A promoted-but-unproposed change therefore cannot be committed with hooks on, and the text form `now <original-text>` avoids this only because it runs propose itself. Either promotion should scaffold the minimum change artifacts or the validators should treat an origin-only change directory as promoted-not-yet-proposed.
